hookSpecificInput.name: Session Context (pdf-mcp)
hookSpecificInput.description: Tool-awareness prompt injected at session start

hooks.script:
# pdf-mcp session context

pdf-mcp is a PDF intelligence MCP server. Before starting work run pdf_status to confirm the server is alive and pdf_help to see the current tool surface. The 10 tools are: pdf_extract, pdf_manipulate, pdf_annotate, pdf_forms, pdf_convert, pdf_validate, pdf_rag, pdf_help, pdf_status, pdf_shutdown. Each domain tool is a portmanteau with an `operation` param - read its docstring for the operation names. At end of work, save any PDFs you want to keep into data/uploads/ and note the job_id in the thread.
